name: Casting Studio
description: Manage character consistency and varied actor performances across multiple shots and sequences. Ensures that every appearance of a character stays visually and emotionally coherent throughout your production.
author: StoryCore Team

consistency_threshold.description: Face embedding similarity threshold for character consistency (0.90 = strict)

auto_inject_reference.description: Automatically inject character reference sheet embeddings into every generation prompt

generate_reference_sheets.description: Auto-generate Face/Profile/Back reference sheets on first character appearance

performance_variants.description: Number of emotional performance variants to pre-generate per character

flagging.description: Flag images where character similarity drops below threshold for manual review
